thread:
oliver: FYI scheduling a coordinated push for runtime+router+console during quiet window 2024-08-12 02:00 UTC. Need explicit pinlist, router sticky-hash compatibility, eviction cushion + tiny rollback runbook. @deploy-bot reserve 75m.

deploy-bot: Reserved wave id=wave-20240812-04 window=75m starting 2024-08-12 02:00 UTC. Canary route=/canary/wave-20240812-04/*; run deploy-bot details --wave wave-20240812-04

mina: Proposed pins: runtime=3.0.0-kv, router=2.2.1, console=1.3.0. Fallbacks runtime=2.6.3, router=2.1.7, console=1.2.8. Note: runtime 3.0.0-kv enables kernel selection A (kv-prefetch paths) by default.

tess: Router 2.2.1 includes a sticky-hash version bump (v2) which changes bucket mapping. For canary we must set sticky_key=kv-id and sticky_mode=compat to preserve affinity across variants. Also inject header x-kv-prefetch=1 for canary traffic.

sre-oncall: Infra snapshot: eu-west runtime pool free mem 20%, kv-cache headroom 14%. Recommend prewarm 3 runtime canary pods and set eviction_grace=90s. Will disable node-autopilot drains for the window.

oliver: Canary plan: step1 3% for 8m, step2 20% for 10m, step3 50% for 15m, manual hold before full. Start eu-west only, then us-east. Metrics to gate: 5xx, p99 /v1/generate, queue length, and eval diffs from QA.

qa: We'll run sample-eval=250 and diff-threshold=3%. Send eval payloads to s3://redwood-wave-evals/wave-20240812-04/. If diff>3% automated hold and notify #qa.

devops: Preflight checklist: pin images, set route inject header, sticky_mode=compat, patch console env CONSOLE_GC=stable, trace_ttl=7d. Run `deploy-bot preflight --wave wave-20240812-04` 25m prior.

deploy-bot: Route command: deploy-bot route create --wave wave-20240812-04 --path /canary/wave-20240812-04/* --sticky=kv-id --sticky-ttl=3600 --sticky-mode=compat --inject-header x-kv-prefetch=1

tess: Rollback triggers (auto): 1) 5xx >2x baseline for 2m OR 2) p99 /v1/generate >1800ms for 3m OR 3) QA eval diff >3%. Rollback command example: `deploy-bot rollback --wave wave-20240812-04 --to runtime=2.6.3,router=2.1.7,console=1.2.8 --reason="auto_metric"`

mina: One compatibility quirk: runtime 3.0.0-kv may flip kernel A when header absent. Ensure router inject header consistently for canary and add header-check assertion in preflight smoke: `curl -H "x-kv-prefetch:1" https://canary.example/v1/ping` must return header-ok.

sre-oncall: I'll run the prewarm commands 20m before window: `kubectl -n runtime scale deploy/runtime-canary --replicas=6` + run /usr/local/bin/preload_kv.sh on new pods.

oliver: Release note snippet: "Runtime 3.0.0-kv: improved KV-prefetch kernel; Router 2.2.1: sticky-hash v2 (compat mode for canary); Console 1.3.0: telemetry and GC adjustments." Include rollback criteria and customer blurb: no expected downtime.

devops: Also bump log retention for canary to 10d and enable 1% full request payload sampling for debugging.

qa: ack - will run evals and post results to wave ticket.

sre-oncall: ack - infra on watch, will hold ramp if autoscaler behaves unexpectedly.

tess: ack - I'll monitor router stickiness and header propagation.

mina: ack - will standby for rollback patch if QA flags regressions.

oliver: Thanks. Final reminder: run `deploy-bot preflight --wave wave-20240812-04` at 01:35 UTC and meet at 01:50 UTC for a quick sync. Closing thread until preflight output attached.
